fato_historico: 1991: Prof. Anita Hill delivers her televised testimony concerning sexual harassment during the Clarence Thomas Supreme Court nomination.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a gentle awakening of your voice and boundaries. Much like the historic moments where truth found its stage, consider this a time to stand firmly in your integrity. Perhaps you feel a renewed sense of purpose, allowing your authentic self to bloom with the quiet confidence of a grounded soul.
frase_do_dia: Your voice carries the power to shift the tides toward peace and truth.
significado_numero: A powerful gateway for manifestation and alignment with your highest spiritual self.
conselho: Speak your truth clearly and trust the wisdom held within your steady heart.
